document.name: Aletheia capability and verification inventory
document.evidence_boundary: The bundled results cover deterministic Northstar fixture data, reviewed rules, build-pinned artifacts, scripted trajectories, and calls routed through the fixture policy adapter. They do not establish live-model quality, customer safety, compliance, production reliability, or market validation.

status_vocabulary.operating: A connected path works in the stated environment and is more than a class, endpoint, or deployment seam.
status_vocabulary.fixture: A connected path works only with bundled deterministic or synthetic data, scripted trajectories, or in-memory evaluation tools.
status_vocabulary.interface_only: A protocol, class, command shape, or explicit failure seam exists, but the named integration does not operate.
status_vocabulary.configuration_only: Configuration or deployment manifests exist, but the external service or complete integration is not provisioned and verified.
status_vocabulary.unverified: Implementation exists, but the current final verification gate or required external end-to-end check has not passed.
status_vocabulary.absent: No operating implementation exists in the repository.

local_product.reason: The settled revision passed its 111-test backend matrix, web/build/Worker checks, and five browser flows. In the current guest candidate, all 67 Vitest tests pass across 17 files and all 116 backend tests pass across two local runs: 115 default plus one real-PostgreSQL test. Hosted guest verification remains separate.

evaluation_mode.reason: The complete review, compile, run, trace, and report path uses the bundled Northstar corpus and deterministic scripted trajectories.

hosted_product.reason: Supabase, Render, Turnstile, and a named Cloudflare staging Worker are provisioned, and the permanent-user Northstar workflow passed there. The newer public-guest candidate is not deployed or hosted-verified, and canonical production remains on the preceding release.

production_readiness.reason: Database-enforced tenant isolation, signed releases, customer runtime enforcement, production ingestion, operating controls, and production assurance are incomplete.

target_architecture.responsibility: Loads the public landing page or public /demo guest entry, then accesses private workspace routes through a signed session.
Issues and refreshes anonymous or permanent sessions and validates Turnstile CAPTCHA for anonymous/email auth.

target_architecture.component: Cloudflare Workers with Next.js and OpenNext
target_architecture.responsibility: Renders public /demo, establishes the guest session, protects workspace routes, refreshes cookies, validates mutations, and proxies same-origin API traffic.
Validates the origin credential and user JWT, enforces membership scopes, and runs domain and operation services.
Stores accounts, workspaces, project data, build/run evidence, operations, guest usage/expiry data, and waitlist consent.

capabilities.name: Public product landing page
capabilities.scope: Explains the policy-CI workflow, refund failure scenario, source boundary, and product path without reading private API data.
limitations: The canonical hostname still serves the preceding release; the guest candidate is not deployed.
No analytics, legal, privacy, or service-status pages are implemented.

capabilities.name: Signed-session review, build, run, and report UI
capabilities.environment: local Northstar workspace; permanent-user staging path
capabilities.scope: Provides source, rule, build, test, run, trace, and report routes backed by the deterministic Northstar workflow for a guest or permanent signed subject.
limitations: The permanent-user hosted workflow passed; the public guest entry and limits remain to verify there.
The current scenario and domain content is Northstar-specific.

capabilities.name: Local no-key authentication mode
capabilities.scope: Uses a fixed API development identity and a loopback-only web bypass so the fixture workflow needs no external identity service.
limitations: The Next.js development server also has a non-production no-Supabase fallback when AUTH_MODE is unset.
This mode must never be used on a public origin.

capabilities.name: Supabase permanent-account authentication
capabilities.scope: Implements email magic-link/OTP, GitHub OAuth, code-only PKCE callback exchange with raw token-hash rejection, cookie refresh, logout, protected-route checks, and in-place anonymous-to-email/OAuth identity linking that preserves the Supabase subject and workspace.
limitations: Magic-link/session behavior passed with hosted permanent users, but default SMTP is limited to project-team addresses.
Manual OTP and GitHub OAuth are deployment-disabled; custom SMTP, revocation, and broader delivery remain unverified.
Attaching an identity owned by another account returns a conflict; automatic workspace merging is not implemented.

capabilities.name: Turnstile protection for anonymous and email authentication
capabilities.scope: Forwards a single-use CAPTCHA token to Supabase anonymous/email auth and destroys/remounts the widget after each attempt. Supabase verifies challenge success; Aletheia action values are client labels. The widget allowlist contains only canonical/staging hosts; local use relies on local auth or Cloudflare's test key.
limitations: The hosted site-key/secret pairing passed on the prior email path; the anonymous sign-in path has not been deployed and exercised.
Native Supabase CAPTCHA does not enforce Turnstile action or hostname response fields.

capabilities.name: Turnstile-protected anonymous guest entry
capabilities.scope: Keeps /demo public, obtains a signed Supabase anonymous session with role=authenticated, and bootstraps an isolated personal Northstar workspace without email or password.
limitations: The candidate path is implemented and locally covered but not deployed or hosted-verified.
It exposes only the seeded evaluation workspace, not uploads or arbitrary project creation.

capabilities.name: Same-origin API proxy and browser mutation boundary
capabilities.scope: Checks session, path, Origin, Fetch Metadata, and double-submit CSRF; strips spoofable credentials; injects bearer and origin credentials; streams responses; configures per-subject 120 general/90 poll/30 heavy per-location thresholds, a 64 KiB mutation cap, and 85 seconds to receive upstream response headers.
limitations: The permanent-user Cloudflare-to-Render path passed on staging; the anonymous JWT path and new edge controls must be reverified.
Cloudflare rate counters are permissive and eventually consistent per location, not exact global quotas; the 85-second bound ends at response headers and does not time the streamed body.
Independent security testing remains pending.

capabilities.name: FastAPI Supabase JWT and origin authentication
capabilities.scope: Defaults to fail-closed production settings, applies pre-routing origin-secret and bearer-presence checks, rejects hosted document uploads before multipart parsing, streams and caps hosted mutation bodies at 64 KiB, and requires a signed role=authenticated JWT with constrained algorithms, key ID, issuer, audience, expiry, and subject; signed anonymous identities enter the bounded guest path.
limitations: External JWT/origin enforcement passed for permanent users on staging; anonymous JWT acceptance remains to verify there.
JWKS rotation, outage, and cache behavior have not been exercised.

capabilities.name: Application-enforced workspace tenancy
capabilities.scope: Implements accounts, personal workspace bootstrap, owner/admin/editor/viewer roles, and membership-scoped project and child-resource lookups.
limitations: Permanent-user hosted two-user isolation passed; guest-to-guest and guest-to-permanent isolation remain to verify.
There is no invitation, membership-administration, group, or service-account workflow.

capabilities.name: Database-enforced tenant isolation
capabilities.scope: Would use RLS or an equivalent private-schema and least-privilege grant boundary.
limitations: Current tenant authorization is enforced only by FastAPI query scopes.
Hosted Data API disablement plus current/default anon/authenticated grant denial passed, but that is coarse browser denial rather than tenant isolation.
RLS or an equivalent private-schema/least-privilege server boundary remains absent.

capabilities.name: Guest limits, expiry, and cleanup
capabilities.scope: Caps guests at 30 successful writes and six live operations, denies reset, expires access after seven days, and cleans anonymous identities after 30 days at startup/every 24 hours. Hosted age is anchored to auth.users.created_at, and auth-only anonymous identities that never bootstrapped the app are included.
limitations: The limits and cleanup behavior have not been exercised against hosted Postgres.
Startup and periodic cleanup are fail-open by design and therefore require alert monitoring.

capabilities.name: Authenticated waitlist consent
capabilities.scope: Accepts normalized unique email consent behind a guest or permanent authenticated API and preserves the consent while clearing its user link during guest cleanup.
limitations: The candidate path is locally covered but not deployed or hosted-verified.
Joining the waitlist does not convert an anonymous identity into a permanent account.

capabilities.name: Versioned source records and source-linked viewer
capabilities.scope: Stores original-byte and normalized-text hashes, parser/normalizer identity and version, source versions, line counts, source references, and exact highlighted spans for bundled sources.
limitations: The hosted workspace uses fictional evaluation data.
Source maps do not yet resolve every generated output span to a stable versioned anchor.

capabilities.name: Local text and document ingestion API
capabilities.scope: Accepts pasted text and bounded UTF-8 txt, Markdown, JSON, YAML, and text-based PDF input; records distinct original-byte and normalized-text hashes plus parser/normalizer provenance.
limitations: There is no upload UI in the current workspace.
No OCR, malware scanning, DLP, quarantine, or object storage exists.

capabilities.name: Secure hosted customer ingestion
capabilities.scope: Would provide quarantined, scanned, access-controlled customer uploads and production connectors.
limitations: Uploads are intentionally disabled in the current hosted evaluation configuration.
FastAPI locally verifies that hosted document uploads are rejected before multipart body parsing; no secure hosted ingestion path exists.

capabilities.name: Fixture candidate extraction
capabilities.scope: Loads checked-in rule candidates and preserves exact source quotes for the seeded workflow.
limitations: It does not extract arbitrary customer policy language.
The broader finding set is seeded rather than recomputed by a general analyzer.

capabilities.name: Structured live-model extraction
capabilities.scope: Defines a provider seam and explicit typed service errors when credentials or an implementation are missing.
limitations: No provider request, structured-output validation loop, quote verification pipeline, or live extraction result exists.

capabilities.name: Conflict, ambiguity, duplicate, and coverage findings
capabilities.scope: Shows known current-versus-legacy conflicts, duplicate guidance, ambiguity, and missing-test findings with proof labels and witnesses.
limitations: There is no domain-neutral conflict engine, bounded solver, or automatic re-analysis of arbitrary uploaded sources.
Analysis and test-generation operation kinds remain placeholders.

capabilities.name: Revision-safe rule and finding review
capabilities.scope: Uses optimistic revisions, forces semantic edits back to review, records a conflict winner/loser/authority/rationale, supersedes the loser, and gates compilation on unresolved critical findings.
limitations: There is no assignment, comment, two-person approval, durable audit actor model, or automatic analyzer rerun before compile.

capabilities.name: Byte-reproducible Northstar artifact compiler
capabilities.scope: Emits prompt, workflow, knowledge, policy, regression tests, pinned sources/rules/findings/tools/facts, source map, README, and a canonical manifest whose exact bytes form the build root.
limitations: Templates and prose remain refund-specific.
Artifacts are stored in database JSON rather than an append-only content-addressed blob store.
Bundles are not signed.

capabilities.name: Domain-neutral compiler and second domain
capabilities.scope: Would compile the same bounded IR across refund and appointment-scheduling corpora without semantic domain branches.
limitations: No appointment-scheduling corpus or generic template router exists.

capabilities.name: Build-pinned fixture execution
capabilities.scope: Verifies the build root and every artifact digest, then reads policy, test specifications and trajectories, tool registry, fact metadata, and runtime domain/lifecycle from the selected build; stores stable test snapshots on scenario results.
limitations: A live TestCase row is still used only as relational FK mapping.
Run, trace, and report labels use the stored result snapshot; the test-authoring screen intentionally shows current project cases.

capabilities.name: Bounded deterministic policy interpreter
capabilities.scope: Evaluates bounded boolean/predicate rules with tool/domain/lifecycle scope, fact/prior-event/approval requirements, argument-correlated approvals, allow/not-applicable exceptions, deny/indeterminate/prerequisite/approval/allow precedence, safe RE2 matching, and proposal-before-execution traces.
limitations: The supported scope vocabulary is intentionally limited to tool, domain, and lifecycle.
Fact values do not come from a typed fact catalog, and generic timezone, operating-window, cooldown, or persisted temporal-monitor semantics are absent.
The compatibility approval path is Northstar-shaped: it correlates exact order/amount values but does not require legacy fixture events to carry tool/rule identity metadata.

capabilities.name: Build-pinned typed tool-call and exact-money boundary
capabilities.scope: Requires a valid Draft 2020-12 object schema with additionalProperties=false for every pinned tool and rejects missing fields, wrong types, nested-schema violations, unknown tools, unsupported adapters, and unexpected properties before policy evaluation or execution; Northstar money is exact USD minor_units.
limitations: This boundary operates only in the scripted in-memory fixture runner, not a customer dispatcher.
There is no typed fact catalog, multi-currency conversion/rounding policy, or generic timezone-aware time system.
It must not be described as a production enforcement boundary.

capabilities.name: Labelled-arm deterministic evaluation
capabilities.scope: Runs the build-pinned suite across the build-declared labelled arms from isolated state with explicit tool/compiler assertions plus computed rule, normative-source, and guarded-boundary coverage; the release gate also rejects unclassified critical rules.
limitations: Trajectories are scripted, not model-generated.
There are no stochastic trials, uncertainty intervals, calibrated judges, human-label studies, or incident-derived regression lifecycle.

capabilities.name: Live model and tool loop
capabilities.scope: Defines an agent-adapter seam that fails explicitly instead of silently substituting fixture results.
limitations: No operating provider call, tool loop, recovery after denial, model capability probe, model digest, or live result exists.

capabilities.name: Fixture traces and self-digested evidence reports
capabilities.scope: Separates proposals, decisions, execution, results, and state changes; reports exact source/test/tool/fact/build/run hashes, parser/normalizer provenance, computed rule/source/boundary coverage, limitations, and a canonical report digest under aligned build/evidence schema-v0.3 contracts.
limitations: Reports are not signed or trusted-timestamped.
Failure rows do not yet deep-link directly to source anchors.

capabilities.name: Signed artifact storage, promotion, and rollback
capabilities.scope: Would store append-only content-addressed blobs, sign roots, verify releases, promote environments, revoke bundles, and retain deployment receipts.
limitations: Current SHA-256 digests detect changes but do not prove signer identity, trusted time, or deployment state.

capabilities.name: Typed asynchronous operation contract
capabilities.environment: local API and permanent-user staging path
capabilities.scope: Returns HTTP 202, Location, and OperationOut; records idempotency and request/input fingerprints; polls progress and validates the result. Snapshot-consuming operations and child mutations use one Project-to-child lock order.
limitations: Permanent-user hosted build/run polling passed; the guest six-operation allowance and new locking revision remain to verify hosted.
There is no cancellation endpoint despite a modeled cancelled state.

capabilities.name: SQL operation worker with leases
capabilities.scope: Claims queued work, limits one running operation per project, assigns leases, extends owned leases with a heartbeat, recovers expiry, retries unexpected failures, dead-letters exhaustion, and handles shutdown.
limitations: The full backend suite and real local PostgreSQL integration passed; no separate hosted worker is deployed.
There is no scheduled backoff, cancellation administration, dead-letter replay UI, metrics, or alerts.

capabilities.name: Separately deployed hosted worker
capabilities.scope: Would execute queued operations independently from the web process.
limitations: The current Render blueprint uses DEMO_INLINE_JOBS=true and defines only one Free web service.

capabilities.name: Local SQLite lifecycle
capabilities.scope: Provides a zero-install local database with Alembic migrations and deterministic seed/reset.
limitations: All five clean Playwright flows and the empty SQLite Alembic upgrade/check passed locally; SQLite does not substitute for the hosted PostgreSQL path.

capabilities.name: PostgreSQL and Supabase database lifecycle
capabilities.environment: hosted Supabase plus isolated local PostgreSQL 14 and PostgreSQL 17 CI
capabilities.scope: Includes PostgreSQL-compatible models, migrations, URL normalization, advisory migration locking, bounded pooling, conditional anon/authenticated table-privilege revocation, and a PostgreSQL lifecycle CI job.
limitations: The hosted database reached the preceding Alembic head and passed Data API/current/default grant denial; the guest migration is not yet applied or verified there.
No backup/restore drill is claimed.
Render Free has no pre-deploy migration command.

capabilities.name: Cloudflare OpenNext deployment
capabilities.environment: named staging verified for preceding revision; guest candidate pending
capabilities.scope: Defines the Next.js/OpenNext Worker entry point, static assets, explicit production and named staging bindings, disabled deployment preview URLs, observability sampling, source maps, and deploy commands.
limitations: A permanent-user revision passed on the named staging Worker, but the guest candidate is not deployed there and canonical production is stale.
Workers Free CPU and bundle limits must be measured with real traffic.

capabilities.name: Render FastAPI deployment
capabilities.environment: provisioned Render Free service; guest candidate pending
capabilities.scope: Defines a Free Docker web service, readiness probe, fail-closed production variables, inline operations, a 64 KiB API mutation cap, guest limits, and fail-open cleanup at startup/every 24 hours, including auth-only anonymous identities. The Free Blueprint omits maxShutdownDelaySeconds and uses the 30-second platform default.
limitations: The service passed the preceding permanent-user staging workflow; guest code and migration are not deployed.
No availability SLO, rollback drill, or durable hosted worker is claimed.

capabilities.name: Supabase Auth and Postgres environment
capabilities.scope: Documents required Auth callbacks, providers, SMTP, CAPTCHA, JWT verification, runtime/migration URLs, and database isolation gates.
limitations: Anonymous sign-in and Turnstile are configured, but the guest application path is not hosted-verified.
Default SMTP is project-team-only; GitHub OAuth is disabled; RLS or an equivalent private-schema boundary is absent.

capabilities.name: Pinned tau Retail sync and normalized manifest
capabilities.scope: Pins Sierra v1.0.1/commit prefix fc0055d, normalizes the reviewed 17-task Retail manifest, records hashes/provenance, and preserves the upstream licence.
limitations: The imported data is simulated, real-world-like benchmark data, not customer data.
Sync/import does not execute or score the benchmark.

capabilities.name: Executed tau Retail adapter
capabilities.scope: Would run selected upstream tasks and preserve smoke/full-split evidence.
limitations: The current run command only validates that imported data exists.
No tau score or quality claim is supported.

capabilities.name: Repository quality and deployment checks
capabilities.scope: Runs Python audit/lint/types/tests, SQLite migration drift, generated contracts, web lint/types/tests, OpenNext build, production/staging Wrangler dry-runs, Playwright, PostgreSQL lifecycle and role-privilege integration, and secret scanning.
limitations: Run 30867243068 passed on implementation commit 5d45a776407955f86227e1890900d9857196a007; this verifies repository checks, not hosted Cloudflare, Render, or Supabase behavior.

capabilities.name: Customer-facing aletheia check command
capabilities.scope: Would return distinct pass, policy-gate-fail, and infrastructure-fail exit codes for a compiled release.
limitations: Current CLI commands compile, run fixtures, and report; they do not provide this release-check contract.

capabilities.name: Customer runtime guard SDK
capabilities.scope: Would verify a signed bundle and mediate a real customer tool dispatcher in observe or enforce mode.
limitations: The current in-memory fixture adapter is not a customer runtime integration.

capabilities.name: Local or hosted model capability probe
capabilities.scope: Would verify exact model presence, structured output, tool calling, context, engine, quantization, and failure state.
limitations: No Qwen/Ollama/vLLM model has been integrated or evaluated.

capabilities.name: Solver-backed bounded analysis
capabilities.scope: Would produce concrete witnesses for supported overlap, conflict, shadowing, and unreachable-policy cases.
limitations: No Z3 integration or supported/unknown solver result contract exists.

capabilities.name: Generic temporal monitor compiler
capabilities.scope: Would compile timezone, operating-window, cooldown, ordering, and prior-event rules into persisted monitors.
limitations: Bounded prior-event correlation now operates in the fixture interpreter, but callback examples are not a persisted generic temporal-monitor or timezone/operating-window system.

capabilities.name: Policy mutation generation and score
capabilities.scope: Would generate valid bounded policy mutants, identify equivalent mutants, report survivors, and gate critical mutation coverage.
limitations: The current mutation tag in a test case is scenario metadata, not mutation testing.

capabilities.name: Team administration and collaborative review
capabilities.scope: Would provide invitations, membership and role administration, assignments, comments, approvals, notifications, quotas, and billing.
limitations: Only the backend membership role model exists.

capabilities.name: Production observability, backup, and incident controls
capabilities.scope: Would include structured telemetry, exception tracking, SLOs, alerts, runbooks, backups, restore drills, privacy controls, and incident response.
limitations: Request IDs, logs, and Cloudflare sampling configuration are not a complete operating-control system.

verification_gates.result: The settled tree passed Ruff, strict mypy, 110 default backend tests, the separately executed PostgreSQL-only test, and the empty SQLite Alembic upgrade/check; all 111 collected backend tests passed across the two database runs.

verification_gates.scope: Strict schema, money, policy-scope, requirement, and no-execution regressions
verification_gates.result: Ruff, strict mypy, and 14 focused policy/runner tests passed for Draft 2020-12 validation, exact USD minor units, pinned domain/lifecycle, bounded prior-event/approval semantics, and rejection before execution.

verification_gates.scope: Aggregated GitHub Actions workflow on the settled commit
verification_gates.result: GitHub Actions run 30867243068 passed quality, secret-scan, and PostgreSQL 17 integration on implementation commit 5d45a776407955f86227e1890900d9857196a007.

verification_gates.scope: Dedicated migrated and seeded E2E SQLite database
verification_gates.result: Five Chromium flows passed: landing/workspace bootstrap, reduced motion and navigation, narrow-width overflow checks, explicit conflict review and compile, and run/trace/report/export.

verification_gates.scope: Local empty PostgreSQL 14 migration, privilege, and operation lifecycle
verification_gates.result: The real local marker passed: migration through head, current/default privilege denial for anon/authenticated roles, bootstrap, queued build/run worker processing, polling, and downgrade cleanup. PostgreSQL 17 CI passed. The target Supabase database reached the preceding head and passed Data API/grant denial; the guest migration remains pending.

verification_gates.scope: Permanent-user Cloudflare to Render to Supabase staging path
verification_gates.result: The permanent-user path passed personal bootstrap, two-user isolation, complete Northstar build/run/trace/report/download, Data API denial, and direct-origin rejection on the named staging Worker.

All 67 web Vitest tests pass across 17 files. All 116 backend tests pass across two local runs: 115 default and one real-PostgreSQL integration test, including the two-session Project-to-child snapshot-lock fence. Hosted verification remains separate.

verification_gates.scope: Guest Cloudflare to Render to Supabase staging and canonical paths
verification_gates.result: The guest build is not deployed. Anonymous sign-in/JWT handling, tenant isolation, guest limits/reset denial, seven-day expiry, auth-created-at plus auth-only cleanup, waitlist persistence, per-location edge policies, two-hop 64 KiB limits, the 85-second response-header deadline, and the full Northstar workflow remain promotion gates.

verification_gates.scope: Load, fault, penetration, accessibility, privacy, backup/restore, and incident exercises
verification_gates.result: No production-assurance exercise is claimed complete.

highest_priority_gaps: Add database-enforced tenant isolation or a verified private-schema and least-privilege grant boundary.

Deploy the guest migration and candidate to staging; verify anonymous Turnstile sign-in, signed-JWT isolation, guest limits/expiry/cleanup/reset denial, waitlist persistence, and the complete Northstar workflow before canonical promotion.
Build a second domain and domain-neutral compiler/analyzer before making general policy-analysis claims.
Add typed fact catalogs, multi-currency/time semantics, a real local-model loop, customer CI command, and guarded runtime SDK only after fixture evidence contracts are stable.
Store and sign build roots with release promotion, rollback, revocation, and deployment receipts.
